July 28, 1941.

Manager of Sung Sing No. 9 Cotton
Mill and son arrested by French
Police at instance of Japanese
Gendarmerie

At 2 a.m. July 27, officers of the French Police,
accompanied by a party of Japanese Gendarmes, visited
House 170 Rue Pershing, and arrested therein Woo Tseng
Yue (吳增裕), manager of the Sung Sing No. 9 Cotton
Mill, and his son Woo Ching Yih (吳中一). The
arrested men are still detained in the French Police
Station.

le. 28/7.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 28 JUL 1941）

1941年7月28日。

申新第九棉纺厂经理及其子
应日本宪兵队要求
被法国巡捕逮捕

1941年7月27日凌晨2时，法国巡捕官员在一队日本宪兵的陪同下，前往贝当路（Rue Pershing）170号，逮捕了该处的申新第九棉纺厂经理吴增裕（Woo Tseng Yue）及其子吴中一（Woo Ching Yih）。被捕者目前仍被拘押在法国巡捕房。

le. 28/7.
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科 1941年7月28日）

Reported arrest of Woo Kwung Sung, Manager of
Sung Sing No. 9 Mill by Japanese Gendarmes in
French Concession
Sir,
At 4 a.m. 27/7/41 Insp. White O. i/c Pootoo Road
Station received a telephone message from Mr. Saker,
director of the Sung Sing No. 9 Mill, stating that the
manager of the factory Mr. Woo Kwung Sung (吴坤生)
and his son Woo Tsoo Yih (吴祖一) were in the custody
of the French Police.
Enquiries show that at about 2.30 a.m. 27/7/41 a
party of Japanese Gendarmes accompanied by Chinese
went to the home of Woo Kwung Sung at 177 Route
Ferguson and took out Woo Kwung Sung and his son Woo
Tsoo Yih. Upon the entry of the party one of the
servants pressed an alarm bell which resulted in a
number of French Police attending and taking the whole
party to Poste Mallet, they later went to Police
Headquarters in Rue Stanislas Chevalier.
The Japanese allege that Woo was concerned in the
murder of the late Special Deputy Commissioner Mr. C.
Agosti and wanted to take the two men to the Hangkow
Headquarters of the Gendarmerie.
Messrs. Saker and Silby, directors of the Company
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE JUL. 28 1941 SPECIAL BRANCH）
（批：July 28/7 Lsdg * N920(C)）
（批：lo/sh S.I.）

关于日本宪兵在法租界逮捕
申新第九纱厂经理吴坤生的报告

先生：
1941年7月27日凌晨4时，普陀路捕房督察长怀特（White O.）接到申新第九纱厂董事萨克（Saker）先生的电话，称该厂经理吴坤生（Woo Kwung Sung）及其子吴祖一（Woo Tsoo Yih）已被法国巡捕扣押。
经查，1941年7月27日凌晨约2时30分，一队由华人陪同的日本宪兵前往费格森路（Route Ferguson）177号吴坤生住所，将吴坤生及其子吴祖一带出。在该队人员进入时，一名仆人按响了警铃，致使多名法国巡捕赶到，并将整队人员带至马勒捕房（Poste Mallet），随后他们又前往士达高拿路（Rue Stanislas Chevalier）的警察总局。
日方声称吴氏牵涉前副总监阿戈斯蒂（C. Agosti）先生遇刺身亡一案，并欲将二人带往宪兵队汉口路总部。
公司董事萨克（Saker）和西尔比（Silby）两位先生
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 1941年7月28日 特务科）
（批：7月28/7 Lsdg * N920(C)）
（批：lo/sh S.I.）
